why: Known only from one AllStays listing (ID 47687, read 2026-11-21: '1st Ave, Fordville', 48.216353,-97.790184, tags 'primitive, playground', no site count, fee, season, phone or update date, no reviews; its only link is ndtourism.com, never a source). Nothing confirms that the city offers RV camping or that a 23-ft rig fits: not on the ND HHS statewide licensed RV park/campground list (Updated 07.17.2025, read 2026-11-21; its only Fordville licences are Fordville Dam, John D Hagen RV Park and Kirby's Kamping, while other Walsh County city parks with camping, e.g. Minto Park and Park River's East Meadow, are licensed); no City of Fordville web page found; gm.py for 'Fordville City Park' returns only the town centroid (no Google place); web searches find no Campendium, The Dyrt, FreeCampsites or city listing for it. Esri imagery 2026-11-21 (500 m frame, rendered) at the AllStays point: a town-block park south of the main street with a ball diamond, playground and picnic tables beside the rail yard and elevator; no pads, pedestals, camping area or parked RVs legible.
